description: ShellBags Explorer command line: parses ShellBags from NTUSER.DAT / UsrClass.dat hives or the live registry.
usage: Parses ShellBags from NTUSER.DAT and UsrClass.dat hives or the live registry. Use it to show which folders a user browsed, including on removable, network or since-deleted locations.
limitation: Shellbags show folders browsed in Explorer, not that files inside were opened. Entries can be missing if keys were cleaned.

parameters.label: Hive directory
parameters.description: Directory to look for registry hives. This or -l is required.

parameters.label: Live registry
parameters.description: Process live registry (requires Administrator rights). This or -d is required.
Process all hives in -d <directory> and remove duplicates. See manual for details.
